2607.15768.title: GeoChrono: Benchmarking and Rethinking Long-Term Temporal Understanding in Remote Sensing
2607.15768.paper_summary: Remote sensing offers an unparalleled vantage point for observing the Earth's long-term surface evolution, yet it demands that a model not only perceive land cover at isolated moments, but also track changes, memorize evolution histories, and reason across time and space. However, existing studies lack a systematic evaluation that dissects these distinct competencies. To fill this gap, we introduce ChronoBench, a multidimensional benchmark that decomposes this task into four progressive cognitive levels (i.e., Land Cover Perception, Temporal Recognition, Long-Term Memory, and Spatio-Temporal Reasoning). The ChronoBench comprises 12 sub-tasks and 17,689 rigorously validated QA (Question-Answer) pairs. Extensive evaluations reveal that mainstream MLLMs fall drastically behind human experts, with Long-Term Memory emerging as the most critical bottleneck. Motivated by this finding, we further propose GeoChrono, an MLLM with enhanced capabilities for tracing, memorizing, and reasoning about long-term geographic evolution. Leveraging the physical prior that geographic parcels remain spatially fixed while their semantics evolve, we design a Temporal Trajectory Encoder~(TempEnc) that constructs per-location temporal trajectories for dedicated land cover evolution modeling, and we introduce a Coarse-to-Fine Token Compressor~(C2FComp) that adaptively preserves dynamic regions while compressing the static background. To support training, we also construct ChronoInstruct, a 104K-sample instruction-tuning dataset spanning all competency levels for training. GeoChrono achieves state-of-the-art performance on ChronoBench, surpassing the leading commercial MLLMs by over 20%, while C2FComp reduces visual tokens by over 56% while retaining GeoChrono's 94.6% performance. The code and data will be available at https://github.com/IntelliSensing/GeoChrono
2607.15768.paper_summary_zh: 遙感提供了一個無與倫比的觀察地球長期表面演變的視角，然而它要求模型不僅能夠在孤立的瞬間感知土地覆蓋，還必須追蹤變化、記憶演變歷史，並在時間和空間中進行推理。<lb/>然而，現有的研究缺乏一個系統性的評估來剖析這些不同的能力。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了ChronoBench，一個多維基準，將這一任務分解為四個漸進的認知層次（即土地覆蓋感知、時間識別、長期記憶和時空推理）。<lb/>ChronoBench包含12個子任務和17,689個經過嚴格驗證的問答（QA）對。<lb/>廣泛的評估顯示，主流的MLLM在這方面遠遠落後於人類專家，其中長期記憶成為最關鍵的瓶頸。<lb/>受到這一發現的啟發，我們進一步提出了GeoChrono，一個具有增強能力的MLLM，用於追蹤、記憶和推理長期地理演變。<lb/>利用地理區塊在空間上保持固定而其語義演變的物理先驗，我們設計了一個時間軌跡編碼器（TempEnc），用於構建每個位置的時間軌跡，以便專門進行土地覆蓋演變建模，並引入了一個粗到細的標記壓縮器（C2FComp），在壓縮靜態背景的同時自適應地保留動態區域。<lb/>為了支持訓練，我們還構建了ChronoInstruct，一個包含104K樣本的指令調整數據集，涵蓋所有能力層次。<lb/>GeoChrono在ChronoBench上達到了最先進的性能，超過了領先的商業MLLM超過20%，而C2FComp在保持GeoChrono 94.6%性能的同時，將視覺標記減少了超過56%。<lb/>代碼和數據將在 https://github.com/IntelliSensing/GeoChrono 提供。
